tools.name: browser_find
tools.description: Find one element and register it as an @eN ref for later tools. Give a natural-language description, a reference image, or an exact locator: css (a CSS selector), tag, or a semantic locator (role, text, label, placeholder, testid, xpath, alt, title); role combines with text and the others. A description is matched against the page's names and roles first; when that is not enough and an AI provider is configured, the screenshot goes to a vision model. An image is matched locally first and only then, if a provider is configured, sent to the model with the screenshot. Explicit locators never call a model.
